[{"name":"wk_next_i","idea":"In-week transitions with integer weights: for the session's last 3 distinct prefix items, items that follow them 1 to 3 steps later in any target-week prefix, weighted 6/3/2 by step and by recency, excluding the session's own prefix items.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 3 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), occ AS (SELECT s.session, s.seq, s.item FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item), nx AS (SELECT o.item AS item, n.item AS item2, sum(CASE d.k WHEN 1 THEN 6 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS w FROM occ o CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) d(k) JOIN sess n ON n.session = o.session AND n.seq = o.seq + d.k WHERE n.item <> o.item GROUP BY o.item, n.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * CASE li.rk WHEN 1 THEN 6 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;"},
{"name":"wk_cobuy","idea":"In-week view-to-buy: for the session's last 5 distinct prefix items, items carted or ordered in other target-week prefixes that contain those items (up to 1000 most recent prefixes per item), integer weighted by recency rank.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 1000), bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, sum(2 + b.o) AS w FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * (6 - li.rk)) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;"},
{"name":"h_cobuy","idea":"History buy-to-buy: for the session's last 5 distinct prefix items, items carted or ordered together with them in history sessions with 2 to 30 bought items (up to 300 most recent sessions per item), orders weighted higher, integer scores.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), b0 AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS mt, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b0 GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), bb AS (SELECT b0.session, b0.item, b0.mt, b0.o FROM b0 JOIN bs ON b0.session = bs.session), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT bb.session, bb.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.item ORDER BY bb.mt DESC, bb.session) AS rn FROM bb JOIN it ON bb.item = it.item) z WHERE rn <= 300), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(1 + 2 * y.o) AS w FROM ps p JOIN bb y ON y.session = p.session AND y.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * (6 - li.rk)) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;"},
{"name":"cobuy","idea":"Pairs of items carted or ordered together in the same history session (2 to 30 bought items), counted by distinct sessions with an order count, as a buy-to-buy co-visitation for later cart and order features.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), bb AS (SELECT b.session, b.item, b.o FROM b JOIN bs ON b.session = bs.session), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS n, sum(y.o) AS n_o FROM bb x JOIN bb y ON x.session = y.session AND x.item <> y.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, n, n_o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY n DESC, n_o DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cnt, CAST(n_o AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ord FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},
{"name":"nextview","idea":"Forward transitions in the last 7 days of history after collapsing consecutive repeats: item2 appearing 1 to 3 steps after item, weighted 1/step, to predict the next viewed item in later features.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH e AS (SELECT session, item, seq, lag(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS pi FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), d AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS r FROM e WHERE pi IS NULL OR pi <> item), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(1.0 / k.k) AS w FROM d x CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) k(k) JOIN d y ON y.session = x.session AND y.r = x.r + k.k WHERE y.item <> x.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY w DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(w AS DOUBLE) AS tv_wgt FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"}]
